main_text.p: cremor ptisanæ ac pulti similis ex alimento virtute ventriculi concoctus.
Membrum chyloseos est principale, vel administrum.

Principale est VENTRICVLVS, qui nimirum est membrum princeps primæ concoctionis, magnæ cavitatis, membranosum, sphæricum, oblongum, multis omnis generis fibris intertextum, cibum masticatum & comprehensum propria caloris sui facultate conficiens, ac in chylum transmutans.Ventricu-lus,
Ventriculi sunt cum tunicæ, ex-qui-bus constat, tum orificia.
Tunicæ seu membranæ sunt propriæ, vel communes.Ventriculi tunicæ,
Propriæ sunt fibrosæ tunicæ, quæ in-tertextas habent fibras.
Propriarum tunicarum alia est Interior, alia Exterior.
Interior, est durior, asperior scru-gosior[?]; fibras habens obliquas cibum retinentes, donec fit in chylum immutatum.
Exterior est minus dura & aspera, habens villos transversos, concoctum cibum expellentes.
Communis tunica est sine fibris, à peri-

page.notes: The catchword "tonco" at the lower right is read with doubt, so it carries [?]. The word "scru-gosior" in the Interior paragraph is not clear and is marked [?]. Faint marks and show-through in the left margin are not transcribed. The left-margin notes are short catchwords or running marginal headings; they are transcribed as notes because they are printed text in the margin.
